disclosure.old_results_role: development diagnosis only; never evidence for new joint-policy confirmation

scope.plant: reuse the preserved articulated hand and its accepted shared contact model
scope.current_physical_domain: original base configurations plus the existing robustness sampler only
scope.new_size_pose_solref_domains: not admitted without new physical/model validation
scope.information: same declared virtual skin, encoders, effort and task requests for all methods; no target mass/friction/pose/contact identity truth in control

development.purpose: architecture, physics/model admission and metric correctness; findings may be used for development
development.seed_policy: explicit new development seeds; old 256 remain seen diagnostic data

confirmation.candidate_design: 32 independent physical seeds x 16 scenarios x 2 or 3 methods; decide only after development/physical validation and resource review
confirmation.pairing: identical actual physical parameters, initial preparation, random stream policy and task schedule within each physical-seed/scenario block

physical_randomization.actual_parameters: save complete realized config in metadata; evaluation/stratification only
physical_randomization.phase_separation: metadata.research_phase is development/confirmation; legacy split=robustness selects physical sampling and is not a confirmation authorization

thresholds.wrist_tracking_guard: V2 development engineering endpoint uses actual wrist encoders, 0.015rad and 0.3s; retained legacy mission has its original definition

motion_tracking.interpretation: Additional full_motion_mission_success requires legacy mission plus actual wrist tracking. Original mission_success and archived outcomes are retained.
motion_tracking.continuous: Requested user motion against actual lift and wrist encoders: fixed-window duration-weighted RMSE, maximum error and absolute-error integral. Never substitute executed reference for user request.

endpoints.mission_success: shared preparation/handoff accepted, no retention or requested-lift tracking failure before release, physical release achieved, complete truth and no physics warning; force guard is reported separately
endpoints.force_safety: all actual instrumented-finger external contact forces at every physical substep and final endpoint, using original per-finger limits/budget plus numerical tolerance; palm/other are recorded without an invented material threshold

initial_stability.name: post-handoff initial stability waiting; not event recovery

static_quality.role: secondary pre-event holding quality; duplicated pre-event conditions must be disclosed

dynamic_quality.role: candidate co-primary quality endpoint after reliability/safety gates; final hypothesis order is not yet frozen
dynamic_quality.cohort: complete fixed window with continuous physical support, raised object and no table support; do not require whole-task success or correct task tracking to retain a physically valid force window
dynamic_quality.paired_contrast: same scenario/physical-seed block jointly eligible for the selected force window; report per-method and joint window coverage with all assigned failures retained
dynamic_quality.interpretation: low force variation while pausing or failing mission cannot establish overall superiority

force_signal.quality: actual target-object finger normal pressures, evaluated as truth only
force_signal.safety: all external instrumented-finger pressure, including environmental collisions
force_signal.filter: V3 symmetric Hann-windowed sinc FIR, cutoff50Hz, span50ms, separately reflected at public handoff and actual public release command boundaries (scheduled0/7.5/12/16). Force at release instant is pre-action holding endpoint. No future release samples enter earlier holding; scheduled static/dynamic interior windows keep V2 values. Force uses substep END plus measured time-zero sample before200Hz sampling. V1/V2 archives unchanged.

tv_decomposition.finger_reversal: (finger_TV - finger_net_drift)/2; nonnegative path retracing, not automatically sensor noise or undesirable oscillation
tv_decomposition.total_force_TV: sum_t abs(sum_i F_i[t+1]-sum_i F_i[t]); distinct from finger_TV
tv_decomposition.normalization: report N variation and N/s rates using the same actual fixed window duration

release.scheduled_denominator: every scheduled assigned trial, including failed preparation
release.physical_exposure: at actual release command, thumb plus at least three target-object finger contacts, raised object, no table support and all-hand target contact above clearance threshold; independent of prior transport failure
release.physical_release: physically exposed and all-hand target contact at/below threshold for 200ms within 3.5s
release.task_qualified_release: physical release plus no prior preparation/retention/transport failure; keep this separate from physical exposure and physical clearance
release.latency: conditional on physical exposure and achieved clearance; failed/nonexposed/censored are null, never zero

endpoints.progress: requested lift/wrists vs actual robot encoders, requested vs executed command reference, pause fraction and public deadlines; executed reference must not redefine requested task success

entire_holding_quality.role: Whole policy holding including the 12s physical pre-action endpoint, retaining early redistribution costs in addition to the fixed static/dynamic windows

event_recovery.right_boundary: exclusive min(next event, release command, actual task failure); boundary sample cannot complete recovery
event_recovery.physical_collision_onset: first measured fixture contact above 0.02N, not command time; require stability before actual exposure
event_recovery.persistent_event: null end means persistent; recovered under changed condition is during, not after
event_recovery.reporting: all planned event rows and status denominators; own-recovered latency is conditional, not a matched contrast; pair same event and disclose outcome selection for exploratory paired latency

statistics.unit: whole paired physical seed across predeclared scenarios and nested noise replicates
statistics.multiple_testing: freeze family and adjustment before confirmation; no new primary significance tests after seeing holdout
